constraints: RUN THE REPRODUCTION CHECK FIRST, before any search. Take curves already on the frozen ICARM snapshot -- including the small rank-14 #244 [0,0,0,-44788551847,2462203786988170] and the rank-15 incumbent #276 -- and recompute rank, naive height, Faltings height and conductor from a-invariants alone. If your numbers do not match theirs, your height definition is wrong and every later comparison is meaningless. Report the agreement explicitly. This gates everything.

RUN THE CHEAP FALSIFIER SECOND: confirm that small parameters really do give small minimal models. Specialise any convenient family over a small parameter box and plot/report height against parameter size. If height does not stay low, say so immediately -- that falsifies the mechanism in H-ECQ-d60d07 and is a genuinely useful negative result, not a failure.

EVERY rank is a certified LOWER BOUND from exhibited points on that exact curve, verified in exact arithmetic. Never an analytic rank, never ellrank r_high alone, never a Selmer bound. Reuse the stdlib-only exact verifier discipline from EXP-ECRANK-e1e30e.
The Mestre-Nagao statistic ORDERS candidates and never certifies. Include a random-sample control of the same size so its efficiency is measured rather than assumed.
DO NOT submit anything to the ICARM endpoint. Submission is a Coordinator decision after review; your job is to produce the submission record, not to send it.
A timeout or crash is an infrastructure outcome, never negative mathematical evidence.
Write ONLY inside your write_scope. Never commit.
